channel.title: Family Packages on YumFam
channel.description: Recent content in Family Packages on YumFam

item.title: Beijing Tangquan Liangzi Sauna — 16-Hour Hot Spring & Sauna from ¥19.9
item.description: Tangquan Liangzi in Shijingshan's Shougang Park area: 6,000㎡ of hot springs and saunas across 3 floors — toiletries provided, kids' play area, PS5 gaming zone, hanfu costume try-on for photos — with a 16-hour ticket from just ¥19.9 for kids.

item.title: Guangzhou Star River Hotel — Near Chimelong, Buy-1-Get-1 2 Nights from ¥999
item.description: Star River Hotel in Guangzhou's Panyu district, minutes from Chimelong: 55㎡ city-view rooms with daily breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids, two pools, and a free shuttle to Chimelong — buy-1-get-1 two nights for ¥999, or a castle-themed river-view family room from ¥669.

item.title: Wuhan Kaiyuan Senbo Resort — Autumn Harvest Stay: 1 Night + 2 Waterpark/Fantasy Island Tickets, from ¥699
item.description: Autumn-limited stay at Wuhan's Kaiyuan Senbo waterpark resort: 1 night in a superior garden-view room, 2 buffet breakfasts, 2 tickets to the indoor water park or Fantasy Island kids' park, plus travel photography, welcome fruit and mini-bar drinks.
